name: AutoGen
titleZh: AutoGen：以多智能体对话构建下一代 LLM 应用
summary: A framework for building applications out of conversable agents, where interaction patterns can be programmed in natural language or in code.
summaryZh: 一个用「可对话智能体」搭建应用的框架，交互模式既可以用自然语言、也可以用代码来编排。
keyFact: AutoGen (Wu et al., arXiv:2308.08155, 2023-08-16) treated multi-agent conversation as the programming model for LLM applications, with agents mixing LLMs, human input and tools.
keyFactZh: AutoGen（Wu 等，arXiv:2308.08155，2023-08-16）把「多智能体对话」当作 LLM 应用的编程模型，智能体可混合使用模型、人类输入与工具。
whyItMatters: Most multi-agent products today are variations on this conversation-pattern idea.
whyItMattersZh: 今天大多数「多智能体」产品，本质都是这套对话编排思路的变体。
title: AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation
